assertion_audit: tests/test_queue_hold_release.py:58-64 fails if override ranking or held phase changes; the latter constant comparison alone would not catch a coordinated rename, but literal held checks at lines 100 and 123 do.
tests/test_queue_hold_release.py:70-78 fails if the remaining queued request vanishes, but cannot detect held occupancy because the test prefilters the ordering input.

tests/test_queue_hold_release.py:95-105 fails if admission launches the held request, release fails to launch it next, or hold/release destroys the saved override; the pre-hold record is separate from the persisted post-release record.
tests/test_queue_hold_release.py:116-136 fails if a plan selector misses either phase, changes another plan, loses waits or override, or counts the 25-hour hold toward queue age.
tests/test_queue_hold_release.py:141-143 fails if a launched run is held or the refusal omits crew stop.
tests/test_queue_hold_release.py:153-161 fails if a session selector touches the other session or release leaves its request held.
tests/test_queue_hold_release.py:183-185 fails if a 25-hour hold has zero or duplicate obligations or loses its reason.

tests/test_queue_hold_release.py:192-197 fails if a held pointer is classified as running, loses its reason, or suggests observe rather than release; classification-base.log reproduced running before the repair.

tests/test_queue_hold_release.py:207-216 fails if CLI and MCP adapters diverge in their returned rows, though a shared wrong implementation would still compare equal; the other behavioral assertions guard correctness.

tests/test_crew_help_names_its_state.py:43-44 and tests/test_run_verbs_share_one_identity_grammar.py:88-89,119-120 fail if the new verbs disappear from help or reject a matching project before reaching their own phase checks.

findings.text: non-blocking: The added plan-read refusal wrapper and audit rewrites at lines 3316-3340 are unrelated to queue hold/release and are not reached by its gate; disposition exempted because they remain inside the granted file and no changed result was observed.

non-blocking: The ordering assertion supplies a manually filtered queued list, so removing held-pointer filtering from fair_share_admission_order still leaves this assertion green and a competing-session occupancy regression untested; disposition folded into a queue-hold-release occupancy regression node.
